source_commit_subject: Reject superseded staged waking turn replay

predecessor_edition.note: The September 24 edition is preserved unchanged as a frozen historical artifact.

build_method.transform: The September edition's exact privacy transform (466 whole-line replacements across 63 files) was recovered by diffing the September source blobs against the published September files, and proven to reproduce the September edition byte-for-byte (63/63 files). The same transform is applied here to the October source blobs.
build_method.unchanged: 231 source files are byte-identical between the September and October commits and ship as their October git blobs.
build_method.added_modules: 16 new October modules that the public bound tests transitively require and that carry no private material are included (see added_october_modules).
build_method.excluded: The private Porch implementation and Porch-adjacent services are NOT published (see excluded_private_modules). Bound test nodes that require them are removed from the bindings; scenarios left with no bound test are reported NOT_ATTEMPTED.

excluded_private_module_reason: These are the native Porch implementation and its pairing/credential surface, which the public-distribution brief forbids publishing. They are not needed by any published file: no included module imports them.

files.packaging_source: copyright line of the anaxi_final/LICENSE git blob + packaging/reference_distribution/distribution/AGPL-3.0.txt (canonical AGPL-3.0 text)
edition README, adapted from the September edition README

october_inventory_additions.note: The October source added two capabilities to owner_completion_inventory.json. Neither has a public binding in this edition; all 26 of their scenarios are reported NOT_ATTEMPTED.

excluded_private_porch_files_reason: llama_gui.py contains the private Porch integration (pairing store, TLS certificate fingerprint, Porch listener, owner-conversation submission) and imports pulse/porch_api/porch_pairing/owner_conversation_service. llama_desktop.py and llama_launch.py import llama_gui; test_llama_launch.py tests llama_launch. None is on the public bound path: the only bound tests that reach llama_gui are the 7 removed for the same reason.
